description: Redux reducers for managing team-related state in the Mattermost application, including current team, team list, members, stats, and group associations.

methods.name: currentTeamId
methods.description: Reducer managing the currently selected team ID.

methods.name: teams
methods.description: Reducer managing the list of teams as a mapped object.

methods.name: myMembers
methods.description: Reducer managing the current user's team memberships.

methods.name: membersInTeam
methods.description: Reducer managing members within each team.

methods.name: groupsAssociatedToTeam
methods.description: Reducer managing groups associated with each team.

methods.name: updateTeamMemberSchemeRoles
methods.description: Helper function to update scheme roles for team members.

methods.name: updateMyTeamMemberSchemeRoles
methods.description: Helper function to update scheme roles for current user's team membership.

methods.name: contentFlaggingStatus
methods.description: Reducer managing content flagging status per team.
